description: Bundles the Visual C++ 2015 UWP runtime DLLs extracted from the Microsoft.VCLibs.140.00 MSIX framework packages shipped with the Windows 10 SDK. Adding this package to a native C++ or managed (.NET Framework 4.5.2+, .NET 8) project copies the matching set of DLLs (selected by Platform / PlatformTarget x Configuration) into the build output directory, so an MSIX-packaged app can also run in an unpackaged context.
releaseNotes: Repackaged from Microsoft.VCLibs.140.00 framework MSIX packages shipped with the Windows 10 SDK.
